purpose: Read a filtered ownership snapshot from one explicitly bound local coordinator

tool.name: dotbox_ownership_status
tool.privacy_disclosure: Reveals coarse human/Dot presence, observation source, viewer mode, connection, freshness, epoch and sequence for one selected viewer
excluded_data: Session, stream, receiver and viewer identifiers
Raw backend replies and error details

local_process_boundary.coordinator_credential: Stays local; separate from the MCP credential
local_process_boundary.risk: The adapter fixes its backend operation to status but does not isolate a compromised connector process from its broader local coordinator credential
local_process_boundary.receiver_binding: Pin current ownership-coordinator descriptor kind and instance; reject game/publisher descriptors and replacement receiver
local_process_boundary.viewer_binding: Pin explicitly configured lowercase SHA-256; do not disclose it remotely
local_process_boundary.legacy_descriptor_rule: Deliberately stop/restart an old unmarked coordinator through normal controls; never manually tag an old or game session

local_test_fixture.credential_output: Private token-file path and expiry only; token is not printed

activation_requirements: Select and review final HTTPS MCP endpoint and exact resource URL
Select an approved OAuth 2.1 authorization server and publish required discovery metadata
Support authorization code with PKCE and resource-bound access tokens
Validate issuer, signature, resource/audience, expiry and required scope for each access token
Review and enforce a single-owner subject/session and OAuth client binding
Keep DNS-rebinding protection and reviewed host/origin restrictions
Keep coordinator and MCP credentials separate and private
Review final connection permissions before deployment or ChatGPT linking
not_activated: OAuth issuer selection, client registration or account grant
qualification_scope: Real authenticated local MCP HTTP with a synthetic ownership publisher; no live viewer or Dot connection, desktop input, handoff or interruption-recovery qualification
